hypothesis: Existing v0.1 can describe unfamiliar cards with explicit gaps; general lexical checks improve mutation detection over A without many clean-A warnings. Semantic compiler accuracy needs independent gold.

selection.frame: A random frame: pinned Standard sets plus BE; collectible nonempty effect text; five gameplay card types; scope exclusions and all 53 A declarations removed
selection.method: Shuffle sorted class strata with random.Random(seed); pop randrange from sorted remaining IDs in each stratum. Repeat until 60. Missing cardClass gets MULTICLASS stratum (original classes retained). Order is draw order. No substitutions.
selection.bias: Class-balanced rather than frequency or type-proportional; rare types and mechanics not guaranteed; no selection using checker capabilities.

process.author: Codex in this chat, not independent automatic compilation or gold
process.context: User task, repository rules/README/roadmap, A report/spec/protocol/source/tests, pinned metadata. No games, protected holdout, online rule sources or external compiler API.
process.model: GPT-6 family per session developer identity; exact serving revision/temperature/top_p/seed unavailable; selection seed is NOT a generation seed
process.order: Freeze protocol commit; implement general checks using A mutations before reading batch texts; freeze checks in a second commit; generate raw batch once; validate/lint/render; self-review with separately stored corrections; independent gold deferred
process.raw: Write-once files; no simulated API calls, no invented raw errors, no retry hidden in first-pass metric
process.closure: Metadata lookups only for explicitly named dependencies; no extra declarations or execution
process.schema: Freeze v0.1; unsupported constructs stay PARTIAL with proposed extensions; no vocabulary additions in B1

metrics.automatic_acceptance: raw structural errors=0 AND old lint=0 AND new lint=0, including PARTIAL separately; not semantic accuracy
metrics.correction: raw/final JSON diff; number of changed cards, correction rounds and leaf operations; includes author self-review (no external human edits)
metrics.detection: paired A and B final-declaration mutations via unchanged A operators; validator/old lint/new-only/missed; equivalent mutations possible
metrics.false_positive: warning counts on unmutated A/B; author disposition only, not an independent false-positive estimate
metrics.effort: record actual generation batches, per-card reviews, check passes, correction rounds and JSON leaf changes; no fabricated minutes

full_B_gates_from_A_section_10.B1_decision: Do not apply final GO/NO-GO or false-acceptance gates before independent user gold; recommend continue next 18 / change process / stop, then STOP.
